Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in, in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred.
A: I was driving on a main road in Katy, stopped at a traffic light behind a line of cars. I had been waiting for a few
seconds when I felt a hard impact from behind.
Q: Did you see the vehicle that hit you before the impact?
A: No. I was looking forward at the light and my mirrors didn't show anything unusual.
Q: How fast do you believe the other vehicle was moving when it struck you?
A: I'd guess it was moving at a reasonable speed, but I didn't have time to react. It was enough to push my car
forward into the vehicle ahead.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene, and did you speak with the other driver?
A: I got out to check on things. The other driver apologized and said they had looked down at their phone for a
moment.
Q: Have you sought medical care since the collision?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed me with whiplash. My neck is stiff and I've had
headaches, and turning my head to the left hurts quite a bit.
Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment or taking medication?
A: I'm doing physical therapy twice a week and I take over-the-counter pain relievers when needed.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I've missed a few days and I've been working modified hours since then.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
